# Micah 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In the last days, the mountain where the LORD's Temple stands will become the most important mountain of all. It will be raised above the other hills, and people from all over the world will stream there to worship.

**2** People from many nations will come and say, "Come, let's go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Temple of the God of Israel. He will teach us how to live, and we will follow His path." For the LORD's teaching will go out from Zion; His word will go out from Jerusalem.

**3** The LORD will mediate between peoples and will settle disputes between powerful nations far away. They will hammer their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer fight against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

**4** Everyone will sit peacefully under their own grapevine and fig tree, and no one will make them afraid. The LORD of Armies has spoken — and it will happen!

**5** Though the nations around us follow their own gods, we will follow the LORD our God forever and ever.

**6** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**7** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**8** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**9** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**10** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**11** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**12** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

**13** "On that day," says the LORD, "I will gather My people who have been crippled, scattered, and broken. I will transform the weak remnant into a strong nation, and I, the LORD, will rule from Mount Zion forever."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **4:1-3**: After the devastating judgment of chapter 3, this vision is breathtaking. The same Temple mount that will be plowed like a field will become the center of the entire world. Destruction isn't the last word.

- **4:3**: Swords into plowshares — the most hopeful image in the Bible. War isn't just stopped; the very tools of violence are repurposed for growing food. That's the depth of the transformation God envisions.

- **4:4**: Everyone under their own vine and fig tree, with no one to frighten them. That's God's ultimate vision — not just world peace in the abstract, but personal safety and abundance for every individual.

— PNEUMA
